description: A detection pipeline in which the article uses transfer learning, where the feature extraction part of a ResNet50 CNN pre-trained on the AffectNet facial expression recognition dataset is applied to webcam video.
title: Video-based automated mind-wandering detection from facial features

description: The article presents a Virtual Patient typology developed from the literature, a review of existing VP systems, results from a student focus-group study, and an international modified-Delphi consensus among VP experts.
title: Virtual Patient typology: 19 factors across four categories

description: The article recommends that analysts choose the hierarchical model for single-case data by first using visual inspection of the data series, then conducting preliminary analyses such as information criteria and likelihood ratio tests.
title: Visual-analysis-guided and sensitivity-checked model specification for single-case effect sizes
